_comment: Config for scripts/i18n-check.mjs (4.B11). dynamicPrefixes: key prefixes assembled at runtime (e.g. $_(`errors.${code}`)) — keys under them are exempt from both the missing and the dead check, since a static scan cannot resolve them. ignoreKeys: exact keys to exempt (escape hatch for keys reserved for upcoming work). Keep this list as small as possible; everything that can be a literal should be one so it is checked precisely.
